risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favor floating-rate and short-duration credit; hedge with TLT puts
Overweight energy (XLE, COP); underweight transport and consumer discretionary; monitor diesel crack spreads
Diversify away from pure-play AI; favor AI infrastructure with revenue proof (Broadcom, Seagate, Snowflake)
Reduce rate-sensitive exposure (REITs, long-duration tech); favor insurance and banks with net interest margin tailwinds
Avoid mid-market consumer names; favor premium (Lovesac) and discount (Walmart) extremes
Maintain 15-20% cash/gold allocation; monitor debt ceiling and election outcomes
Favor US-domestic producers; monitor cross-border manufacturing shifts

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. 10Y yield above 5%, oil surge, and AI narrative risk create headwinds. S&P 500 at risk of 10% correction per MRA strategist. Fed hike expectations and Trump pressure create policy uncertainty. Expect volatility in chipmakers and rate-sensitive sectors.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle intact (Broadcom, Anthropic IPO, AI agents in payments). Insurance and energy structurally benefit from higher-rate regime. Consumer bifurcation continues. Canada positioned for industrial investment cycle. Fiscal risk is the primary wildcard.
